My device does not appear - what should I do?
Ensure Bluetooth and location permissions are granted. Start device scan from Connection; verify the device advertises as VANGO DISPLAY or VANGO IO MODULE. Add via QR or manual MAC if needed.
Restart the device, move the phone closer, and select the correct MAC on the pairing screen. Close any other active BLE connection.
Remote does not work or respond.
Sign in to myhexnet, ensure the device is registered on the panel, enter MQTT credentials on the Remote screen and tap Connect. Check your internet connection.

Grant camera permission and ensure the code is clear and well lit. You can enter the MAC address manually if scanning fails.

1. Power the IO module and open Bluetooth.
2. Go to Settings → Connection and select the VanGO IO module.
3. After the link is live, use Home for lights, Water, Climate, Motor and Energy.
4. For cloud control, sign in on Profile and switch Connection to Remote.

VanGO is a tablet panel for the caravan. Relays and dimmers follow live telemetry from the IO module. Tanks, climate and energy pages show sensor values when the IO reports them. Panel layout can be edited in Settings → Panel settings. Theme, language and notifications stay on this tablet.

Mount the IO module in a dry, ventilated location. Keep BLE and Wi‑Fi antennas clear of metal. Pair once from Connection; the app remembers the last MAC. Register the Wi‑Fi MAC on myhexnet if you will use remote access. Do not power-cycle during a firmware update.

Disconnect 12 V before wiring. Use fuses sized for each load. Water pumps and heaters must have mechanical fail-safes. VanGO is a control UI - it does not replace vehicle or gas safety devices. If a command does not match the IO state, treat the hardware as the source of truth.
